# The Ultimate Python Terminal Ecosystem

A curated, logically ordered note of modern, Python-native terminal utilities that can be installed directly via `uv`.

## 📝 Text Editing & AI

Tools for writing code and getting assistance without leaving the terminal.

* **[`textual-code`](https://github.com/Nesswit/textual-code)** (`uv tool install textual-code`): The best modern TUI code editor. Built on Textual, offering VS Code/Sublime-like features (file explorer, multi-cursor, mouse support) out of the box. *(Note: requires Python 3.12+)*
* **[`amp-editor`](https://github.com/jmacdonald/amp)** (`uv tool install amp-editor`): A fast, Vi-inspired editor with built-in fuzzy finding. A direct upgrade from minimalist editors like `babi`.
* **[`caffee`](https://github.com/iamthe000/CAFFEE_Editor)** (`uv tool install caffee`): A lightweight, actively maintained, and fast minimalist editor.

## 📁 File & Data Exploration

Replacements for standard file browsers and data viewing tools.

* **[`ranger-fm`](https://github.com/ranger/ranger)** (`uv tool install ranger-fm`): The classic, highly customizable terminal file manager with Vim bindings and a multi-column preview layout.
* **[`visidata`](https://github.com/saulpw/visidata)** (`uv tool install visidata`): The "Excel of the terminal." Incredibly fast tabular data explorer for CSV, Excel, SQLite, and JSON files.
* **[`pyfx`](https://github.com/cielong/pyfx)** (`uv tool install pyfx`): An interactive JSON viewer and query engine (using JSONPath). A Python alternative to `jq`.
* **[`parqv`](https://github.com/sanspareilsmyn/parqv)** (`uv tool install parqv`): A TUI specifically designed for exploring and understanding large Parquet, JSON, and CSV datasets.
* **[`frogmouth`](https://github.com/Textualize/frogmouth)** (`uv tool install frogmouth`): A terminal-based Markdown browser with clickable hyperlinks and beautiful rendering.
* **[`rich-cli`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich-cli)** (`uv tool install rich-cli`): A massive upgrade to `cat`. Renders files with full syntax highlighting and proper formatting.

## 🌐 Networking & APIs

Tools for querying, testing, and debugging network requests.

* **[`posting`](https://github.com/darrenburns/posting)** (`uv tool install posting`): A beautiful Postman/Insomnia alternative for testing HTTP APIs right in the terminal.
* **[`httpie`](https://github.com/httpie/cli)** (`uv tool install httpie`): A modern, human-friendly replacement for `curl` with colorized output and an intuitive syntax.
* **[`mitmproxy`](https://github.com/mitmproxy/mitmproxy)** (`uv tool install mitmproxy`): An interactive, SSL-capable intercepting HTTP proxy for inspecting and modifying network traffic.

## 🗄️ Database Management

Database interaction and exploration without bulky GUIs.

* **[`harlequin`](https://github.com/tconbeer/harlequin)** (`uv tool install harlequin`): A drop-in terminal IDE replacement for DBeaver/DataGrip. Supports DuckDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL, etc., with a schema sidebar and query editor.
* **[`litecli` / `pgcli` / `mycli`](https://github.com/dbcli/litecli)** (`uv tool install litecli`): Database REPL replacements offering syntax highlighting and smart, context-aware autocomplete.

## ⚙️ System & Infrastructure

Monitoring system resources, logs, and containers.

* **[`glances`](https://github.com/nicolargo/glances)** (`uv tool install glances`): The absolute powerhouse system monitor. Tracks CPU, RAM, Docker, GPUs, temperatures, and network speeds all at once.
* **[`bpytop`](https://github.com/aristocratos/bpytop)** (`uv tool install bpytop`): A highly stylish, visually impressive system monitor with process trees and mouse support.
* **[`s-tui`](https://github.com/amanusk/s-tui)** (`uv tool install s-tui`): Focused hardware monitor to track CPU temperature, frequency, power consumption, and thermal throttling (includes stress testing).
* **[`sen`](https://github.com/TomasTomecek/sen)** (`uv tool install sen`): A comprehensive TUI dashboard for managing Docker containers and images.
* **[`toolong`](https://github.com/Textualize/toolong)** (`uv tool install toolong`): A modern replacement for `tail -f` and `less` for tailing, searching, and filtering log files in real-time.

## 🔧 Git & Development Utilities

Making daily developer workflows smoother.

* **[`pygitzen`](https://github.com/SunnyTamang/pygitzen)** (`uv tool install pygitzen`): A Python-native Git dashboard to stage files, view diffs, and commit without remembering complex commands.
* **[`icdiff`](https://github.com/jeffkaufman/icdiff)** (`uv tool install icdiff`): Improved colored diffs. Displays side-by-side terminal diffs with word-level color coding.
* **[`ptpython`](https://github.com/prompt-toolkit/ptpython)** (`uv tool install ptpython`): An advanced interactive Python REPL with real-time syntax highlighting, multiline editing, and IDE-like autocomplete.
* **[`howdoi`](https://github.com/gleitz/howdoi)** (`uv tool install howdoi`): Scrapes StackOverflow to give you instant code snippets in the terminal (e.g., `howdoi reverse list in python`).

## 📅 Task Management & Automation

Organizing workflows, schedules, and scripts.

* **[`poethepoet`](https://github.com/nat-n/poethepoet)** (`uv tool install poethepoet`): The ultimate Python task runner. Replaces Makefiles by letting you define scripts and commands directly in your `pyproject.toml`.
* **[`cronboard`](https://github.com/antoniorodr/cronboard)** (`uv tool install cronboard`): A TUI dashboard for managing cron jobs visually. Lets you create, pause, and delete tasks, and translates complex cron syntax into plain English in real-time.
* **[`yacron`](https://github.com/gjcarneiro/yacron)** (`uv tool install yacron`): A modern, YAML-based replacement for cron that reliably handles logging and overlapping background jobs.
* **[`taskdog`](https://github.com/Kohei-Wada/taskdog)** (`uv tool install taskdog`): A local-first TUI task manager with Gantt charts and dependency tracking for personal schedules.
* **[`kanban-tui`](https://github.com/Zaloog/kanban-tui)** (`uv tool install kanban-tui`): A clean, keyboard-driven Kanban board for the terminal.
